'''Iron Ore''' is obtained from [[Mining#Iron Node|Iron Nodes]] with a [[Pickaxes|pickaxe]]. Mining an Iron Node will yield between 1 and 3 Iron Ore. The [[Skills#Mining|Miner Profession]] can further increase this.

==Locations==
* Can be bought at the [[Blacksmith]] for {{Price|150}} each in Year 1 and for {{Price|250}} each in Year 2+
* [[The Mines]] (Floors 41 - 79) have a high concentration of [[Mining#Mining Nodes|Iron Nodes]] with potential abundance at Floors 71 - 79.
* Nodes can spawn in the [[Quarry]], the [[Quarry Mine]], or in the quarry on the [[Farm Maps#Hilltop|Hill-top]] and [[Farm Maps#Four Corners|Four Corners]] Farm Maps.
* Can be found at any floor of the [[Skull Cavern]] and [[Volcano Dungeon]].
* Can be found by [[Hoes|tilling]] soil in [[the Mines]].
* Can be found in breakable crates and barrels in [[the Mines]].
* Can be dropped by [[Metal Head]]s in Floors 81-119 of [[the Mines]], by [[Stone Golem]]s in Floors 31-39 or by [[Slimes|Iron Slimes]].
* Can be found inside any of the 4 types of [[Minerals#Geodes|Geode]].
* Can be found in [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]].
* Can be found by [[Pans|panning]].
* Occasionally sold at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|10}}.
* Can be found in [[Garbage Can]]s outside the [[Blacksmith]].
* Can be [[Recycling Machine|recycled]] from [[Trash (item)|Trash]] with a 21% chance.
* An [[Ice Pip]] [[Fish Pond]] can produce 5 Iron Ore when the population of the pond reaches 3.
* Can be purchased from [[Clint]]'s [[Desert Festival#Villager Shops|shop]] at the [[Desert Festival]] for {{Price|4|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s each.

==Smelting==
Iron ore can be smelted in a [[Furnace]] to create an [[Iron Bar]]. The smelting requires 5 iron ore and 1 [[coal]] to begin and takes 2 in-game hours to complete.

==Tailoring==
Iron Ore can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[Tailoring|Turtleneck Sweater]]. [[File:Shirt178.png|24px]]

==Quests==
Ten Iron Ore are requested by [[Ice Pip]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 1 to 3.
